title: SALTED: a symmetry-adapted machine-learning program for predicting electron-densities in molecules and materials
title_zh: SALTED：对称适配电子密度学习程序
summary: SALTED把量子力学电子密度学习封装为可复用程序，核心是对称适配的原子中心线性展开，而非只预测能量或力。该表示天然连接原子轨道基电子结构代码，可在分子和材料构型间利用相似局域环境实现迁移。文摘未给出误差数值，但对象从势能面推进到n(r)，对机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量、缺陷电荷和张量性质预测有直接方法学价值。
abstract: arXiv:2609.03576v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: SALTED provides an open-source Python package for machine learning the quantum-mechanical electron density, n(r), in molecular and condensed-phase systems based on input atomic coordinates and species. The program adopts a linear atom-centered decomposition of the electron density, which makes it highly transferable across diverse atomistic configurations sharing similar chemical environments. Because of this representation choice, SALTED is naturally interfaced with state-of-the-art electronic-structure programs based on atomic orbitals, namely CP2K, FHI-aims, and PySCF, from which reference electron-density data can be generated and used to train a model. The learning algorithm is based on a symmetry-adapted extension of Gaussian process regression, making SALTED especially efficient in small-data regimes. Thanks to the implementation of vector-field kernel functions, SALTED can also learn the first-order response of the electron density to applied electric fields, partial n(r)/partial E. The application of SALTED within computational workflows has already shown its utility in a wide variety of contexts, including the calculation of polarization vectors and polarizability tensors, the accurate evaluation of Coulomb forces in QM/MM molecular-dynamics simulations, and electronic-structure studies of large-scale 2D materials.

title: Machine learning interatomic potentials for solid-state precipitation
title_zh: 固态析出的机器学习原子间势
summary: 该工作把机器学习势开发从普通能量/力误差转向析出相变过程的热力学可用性验证。核心做法是用晶体对称枚举构造多组元合金相变构型，并用半巨正则Kendall-τ衡量跨成分自由能或稳定性排序是否正确。摘要未给具体误差，但提出的排序指标对合金相变、缺陷聚集和相图模拟比均方误差更贴近物理任务。
abstract: Author(s): Lorenzo Piersante and Anirudh Raju Natarajan Machine-learning interatomic potentials now model complex alloys with near a b i n i t i o precision, but two challenges persist. Researchers must generate training data tailored to the physical process of interest, and they need validation metrics that go beyond simple statistical errors. Here the authors introduce a crystal-symmetry-based enumeration scheme for structural phase transformations in multicomponent alloys and a semi-grand-canonical Kendall-τ that quantifies thermodynamic accuracy across composition. These tools yield a general-purpose Mg-Nd potential. Simulations reveal a subtle interplay between chemical ordering and structural rearrangement and elucidate the continuous hcp-to-bcc transition underlying precipitation in this alloy. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 093802] Published Fri Sep 04, 2026

title: Orbital-Free DFT-Assisted Machine-Learned Molecular Dynamics for Electric-Field-Driven Ionic Transport
title_zh: OFDFT辅助电场离子输运机器学习MD
summary: 该方法把电场作用拆分为机器学习势的短程力和OFDFT电子密度导出的环境依赖电荷力。关键细节是从OFDFT密度做Bader分区，电荷与外场矢量相乘后叠加到MLP力上，从而避免每步昂贵的Kohn-Sham DFT。摘要未报告迁移率或加速倍率，但思路直接面向电场下离子传输、忆阻和电池界面等非平衡凝聚态模拟。
abstract: arXiv:2609.03518v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose an orbital-free density functional theory (OFDFT)-assisted machine-learned molecular dynamics method in which field-independent interatomic forces are evaluated using a machine-learned potential and atomic charges that depend on the local environment are obtained from OFDFT calculations. The atomic charges obtained by Bader partitioning of the OFDFT electron density are multiplied by the electric-field vector and added to the forces from the machine-learned potential. This approach enables molecular dynamics simulations under an electric field at a lower computational cost than Kohn-Sham DFT (KSDFT)-based molecular dynamics. As a proof of concept, the method was applied to beta-Li3PS4 bulk and an S8/Li3PS4 heterostructure under periodic boundary conditions. For Li3PS4 bulk, OFDFT yielded Li charges and a total charge of the PS4 unit consistent with those obtained using KSDFT. In the heterostructure, Li ions migrated from the Li3PS4 region into the S-rich region within a simulation time of approximately 170 ps. Accompanying this migration, the mean Bader charge of the S atoms that initially formed S8 rings changed from nearly neutral to negative. A comparison with KSDFT for a representative interfacial structure also confirmed that the negative charging of the S atoms upon the arrival of Li and the magnitude of the Li charges were qualitatively reproduced. These results demonstrate the possibility of treating field-driven ionic transport and changes in interfacial charge states using a universal machine-learned potential without training an additional material-specific charge-prediction model.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Surrogate for Oxygen Vacancy Dynamics in epitaxial SrTiO₃ on Si memristors via Dynamic Spectral Optimization
title_zh: SrTiO3/Si忆阻氧空位PINN代理模型
summary: 该文把物理信息神经网络用于SrTiO3/Si忆阻器氧空位与电子耦合输运，重点解决氧化物薄膜和厚Si衬底带来的强多尺度刚性。模型采用级联PINN，并配合定制二阶Chebyshev第二类多项式动态谱优化器DSO V2 Hybrid。摘要未给I-V误差或速度指标，但器件对象和氧空位动力学与氧化物存储材料建模有清晰交叉。
abstract: arXiv:2609.02966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer a promising framework for modeling semiconductor devices, yet standard architectures struggle with severe numerical stiffness and multiscale spatial discrepancies inherent to oxide heterostructures. Here, we demonstrate a cascaded PINN architecture coupled with a custom second-order Chebyshev second kind polynomial spectral optimizer (DSO V2 Hybrid) to model ion-electronic drift-diffusion transport in Pt/SrTiO₃/Si memristive heterostructures across a 20 nm STO film on a 380 μm Si substrate. By isolating potential, carrier density, and vacancy transport into four sequentially trained sub-neural-networks, our model circumvents condition numbers exceeding 10¹⁶ without operator splitting. The trained surrogate reproduces experimental conductive-AFM current-voltage hysteresis (R² > 0.96) while ensuring strict Poisson consistency across continuous space. Compared to conventional finite-element solvers (e.g., COMSOL), the PINN surrogate enables differentiable inverse parameter estimation and linear time inference.

title: Scaling Neural Network Quantum States for Ab Initio Quantum Chemistry
title_zh: 从头算量子化学神经网络量子态扩展
summary: 该文系统刻画神经网络量子态在从头算量子化学中的缩放行为，而非只展示单个最优模型。其物理条件自回归NNQS分别在两个六分子源基准训练，并扫描8种模型大小与5个优化里程碑，发现大模型优势受优化充分性共同控制。摘要未给能量误差数值，但对用神经波函数替代传统组态展开的可扩展性评估有方法意义。
abstract: arXiv:2609.02929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural-network quantum states (NNQSs) can represent many-electron wave functions without explicitly enumerating the determinant space, but their accuracy depends jointly on model size and variational-optimization effort. Here we characterize this dependence for a physics-conditioned autoregressive NNQS trained separately on two six-molecule source benchmarks. Across eight model sizes and five optimization milestones, we find that model size and optimization steps jointly shape the energy error. The capacity advantage of larger models becomes more apparent with sufficient optimization, while the returns from additional optimization vary with model size. We capture this coupling using an interaction scaling law and quantify the cumulative compute of each evaluated configuration. The resulting error-compute Pareto frontiers provide a practical decision rule for jointly selecting model size and optimization steps under a given compute budget within the evaluated range. Furthermore, we find that this beneficial scaling trend persists during fine-tuning on held-out N₂. Pretrained models show decreasing error with increasing model size, with a steeper reduction following pretraining on the Hard benchmark. Together, these results place autoregressive neural quantum states within the broader landscape of empirical neural scaling and open a quantitative route toward the systematic scaling of neural quantum solvers for ab initio quantum chemistry.

title: Revisiting quantum effects on dislocation glide in bcc metals from DFT calculations and machine-learning potentials
title_zh: DFT与机器学习势重访bcc金属位错量子效应
summary: 该文用更接近DFT精度的机器学习势替代经验势，重新检验bcc金属位错滑移中的零点运动解释。核心是先用DFT刻画位错能量景观，再用MLIP扩展到原子尺度塑性模型，避免经验势误差掩盖量子效应。摘要给出的最强结论是量子效应确有贡献但不能完全解释低温流动应力差异，对缺陷动力学中势能面精度与量子修正的分离很有启发。
abstract: arXiv:2606.17954v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum zero-point effects have been long proposed to explain a well-known discrepancy between the low-temperature flow stresses of body-centered cubic metals and corresponding atomistic models of plastic flow. Previous investigations on quantum effects relied on empirical interatomic potentials, which poorly reproduce dislocation energy landscapes compared to density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Here, we revisit this problem using DFT and machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). We show that while quantum effects do contribute to dislocation glide at low temperature, their magnitude is much lower than previously reported, and insufficient to reconcile atomistic predictions with experiments. Our results thus reopen a long-standing question and challenge for predictive atomistic modeling, on a fundamental property of crystals.

title: Accelerated stable structure prediction of Li-intercalated bilayer graphene using a data-efficient deep learning framework
title_zh: 数据高效深度学习预测嵌锂双层石墨烯
summary: 该文面向Li插层双层石墨烯的稳定构型搜索，突出数据高效深度学习而非传统枚举或全量DFT筛选。可推断其核心在小样本训练、候选构型生成或主动选择上，但给定摘要未提供网络架构、训练样本数、能量误差或发现的新相。对二维能源材料和插层结构搜索有潜在价值，但定量判断需阅读全文。
abstract: npj Computational Materials, Published online: 04 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41524-026-02314-4 Accelerated stable structure prediction of Li-intercalated bilayer graphene using a data-efficient deep learning framework

title: Field-aware and charge-informed machine learning for predicting molecular and condensed-phase responses and vibrational spectra
title_zh: 场感知电荷信息机器学习预测响应光谱
summary: 该文把机器学习性质预测从静态结构-标量映射推进到外场响应和振动谱预测。核心创新是同时引入场感知与电荷信息，使模型能处理分子和凝聚相在外电场下的响应，而不仅是平衡能量。摘要未给网络结构和误差数值，但对红外/Raman谱、极化率、介电响应和电场驱动材料模拟具有直接方法价值。
abstract: npj Computational Materials, Published online: 04 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41524-026-02293-6 Field-aware and charge-informed machine learning for predicting molecular and condensed-phase responses and vibrational spectra

title: Unveiling the Activity Descriptors for Metal Nanoclusters-N4C as Electrocatalysts through Machine Learning and Experimental Validation
title_zh: 机器学习揭示金属纳簇-N4C析氧描述符
summary: 该文聚焦金属纳簇-N4C电催化的位点特异活性，试图用机器学习电子描述符化解纳簇尺寸敏感性。方法组合为高通量DFT筛选、ML描述符分析和实验验证，目标反应是析氧反应。摘要未给最佳催化剂、过电位或模型精度，因此只能确认其在催化描述符发现上有应用价值，与团队核心凝聚态问题交叉较弱。
abstract: Metal nanoclusters are very difficult to explain as catalysts. Unlike bulk metals, their properties change significantly with every atom added or removed, making it nearly impossible to explain and predict the site-specific activity of the given catalytic reaction using traditional approaches. This unpredictability has made the explanation and rational design of nanocluster catalysts a long-standing open problem. Here, this complexity is resolved for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) through a combined high-throughput DFT screening and machine learning-driven electronic descriptor analysis of 62 earth-abundant metal nanoclusters (Fe, Co, Ni; n = 5–38) supported on nitrogen-doped graphene. Evaluation of 211 distinct surface sites identifies Ni19@N4C as the most active catalyst, with optimal d-orbital occupancy and metal-adsorbate bonding strength (ICOHP), delivering a theoretical overpotential of 0.39 V. ΔGOOH is identified as the key energy descriptor for predicting overpotential(η). Integration of these datasets into a machine learning framework reveals that the Random Forest Regression model (R2 = 0.87) is the best one, with the d-band frontier down(df(::downarrow:)) as the primary electronic descriptor in the multi-descriptor framework, confirming that local frontier orbitals near the Fermi level affect reactivity in these confined systems. The computational predictions led to the synthesis of the NiNC@NGC catalyst, which underwent electrochemical testing. The experimental trends confirmed the theoretical findings with an IR-corrected overpotential(η10) of 460 mV and a Tafel slope of 94 mV dec− 1, which is comparable to the performance of commercial RuO2. This work provides an explainable, descriptor-based framework for decoding the electronic complexity of metal nanocluster catalysts and offers a reliable computational pathway for accelerating the discovery of scalable, earth-abundant OER electrocatalysts.

title: Beyond DFT: Quantum Chaos and Neural Networks for 2D Material Device Design
title_zh: 量子混沌与神经网络设计二维器件
summary: 该预印本尝试绕开DFT，用量子混沌指标和MLP预测Se掺杂MoS2 FET的量子稳定性与电流-电压响应。模型输入包括偏压、杂质浓度和晶格尺寸，输出Brody参数β及I-V曲线，测试R2超过0.93。若数据来源可靠，该思路可作为二维器件快速代理模型；但摘要未说明训练标签是否来自实验、紧束缚还是NEGF，物理可信度需严审。
abstract: Accurate prediction of quantum stability in Selenium-doped MoS 2 field-effect transistors (FETs) remains challenging due to the computational cost of ab initio methods. Here, we combine quantum chaos theory with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network to predict the Brody parameter (β) and current-voltage characteristics without relying on density functional theory. Our MLP model achieves R 2 > 0.93 on test data, accurately capturing the dependence of quantum chaos on bias voltage, impurity concentration, and lattice size. We demonstrate that quantum stability is tunable, not intrinsic, and uncover a universal scaling law where system size governs the transition from integrable to chaotic behavior. This framework bridges atomistic theory and device engineering, enabling rapid design of stable MoS 2-based electronic devices.

title: FPGA Implementation of a CNN-based Topological Trigger for HL-LHC
title_zh: HL-LHC的CNN拓扑触发FPGA实现
summary: 该文属于高能物理触发系统中的边缘AI实现，目标是在HL-LHC严格延迟约束下用FPGA运行CNN事件分类。方法包括全事件图像表示、硬件感知网络结构优化和模拟数据上的物理性能评估。它与凝聚态材料模拟没有直接科学交叉，最多在低延迟神经网络部署层面提供工程参考。
abstract: arXiv:2503.09428v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The implementation of convolutional neural networks in programmable logic, for applications in fast online event selection at hadron colliders, is studied. In particular, an approach based on full event images for classification is studied, including hardware-aware optimisation of the network architecture, and evaluation of physics performance using simulated data. A range of network models are identified that can be implemented within resources of current FPGAs, as well as the stringent latency requirements of HL-LHC trigger systems. A candidate model that can be implemented in the CMS L1 trigger for HL-LHC is shown to be capable of excellent signal/background discrimination for a key HL-LHC channel, HH(bbbb), although the performance depends strongly on the degree of pile-up mitigation prior to image generation.

title: Machine Learning‐Driven Alloy Anode Accompanied by Interfacial Kinetic Compensation Design Toward High‐Rate Zinc Pouch Cells
title_zh: 机器学习设计高倍率锌软包合金负极
summary: 该文题名显示其将机器学习用于锌电池合金负极设计，并强调界面动力学补偿以实现高倍率软包电池。可能涉及合金成分筛选、界面反应动力学和器件级倍率验证，但给定信息没有具体材料、网络模型或容量保持率。与团队能源材料和ML筛选有一定交叉，但目前只能记录为需查全文的应用型工作。
abstract: Angewandte Chemie International Edition, EarlyView.

title: Resolving the Magnetic Ground-State Controversy in RuO2 through A Flat Magnetic Energy Landscape
title_zh: 平坦磁能景观解释RuO2磁基态争议
summary: 该文把RuO2磁基态争议归因于平坦磁能景观，解释非磁和交替磁实验结果可能对样品条件高度敏感。核心模型是环境依赖自旋-晶格框架，同时包含局域Heisenberg交换、巡游Stoner-Landau自旋涨落和SOC介导自旋-晶格耦合，并由高通量第一性原理数据库机器学习参数化后大规模Monte Carlo求解。它直接服务交替磁性、自旋-晶格耦合和磁有序有限温稳定性研究。
abstract: arXiv:2609.03274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rutile RuO2 is a prominent candidate for altermagnetism, yet its magnetic ground state remains highly controversial, with experiments reporting either a nonmagnetic state or altermagnetic order. Here, we develop a generalized environment-dependent spin-lattice framework that unifies localized Heisenberg exchange, itinerant Stoner magnetism via Landau spin fluctuations, and spin-orbit-coupling-mediated spin-lattice interactions. Parameterized from a high-throughput first-principles database using machine-learning and solved by large-scale Monte Carlo simulations, the framework reveals an exceptionally flat magnetic energy landscape in RuO2, where the nonmagnetic state lies nearly degenerate with multiple altermagnetic configurations. We find that material perturbations, exemplified by intrinsic defects, select distinct magnetic ground states primarily by modifying the localized Heisenberg exchange, with perturbation-induced itinerant Stoner polarization provides an essential secondary contribution. Spin-orbit coupling controls the orientation and stability of the Néel vector, but does not determine the emergence of long-range magnetic order. These results provide a unified explanation for the conflicting experimental observations and establish a general microscopic framework for understanding how material perturbations select competing magnetic ground states in systems with nearly flat magnetic energy landscapes.

title: Interplay of B-Site Off-Centering and Molecular Orientations in the Mixed Hybrid Perovskite MAGe1xSnxI3
title_zh: MAGe1-xSnxI3中B位离心与分子取向
summary: 该文用机器学习原子间势大规模MD绘制MAGe1-xSnxI3从Ge到Sn全组分的结构行为，揭示B位离心、八面体倾斜和MA分子取向之间的竞争。关键结论是MAGeI3强极性B位离心在接近立方相变前几乎保持，而MA取向有序随温度逐步减弱；Sn端则呈现不同耦合。该工作紧贴无铅卤化物钙钛矿极性动力学和MLIP有限温模拟。
abstract: arXiv:2609.03510v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: B-site mixing is a common strategy for tuning properties of halide perovskites. In the lead-free system MAGe1-xSnₓI3, it brings tilting and off-centering into competition. Using large-scale molecular dynamics driven by a machine-learned interatomic potential, we map the structural behavior across the full composition range. MAGeI3 exhibits strong polar B-site off-centering that remains nearly constant up to the cubic transition, together with methylammonium (MA) orientational order that weakens progressively on heating. By contrast, MASnI3 combines octahedral tilting with weaker, predominantly antipolar off-centering. Ge-like behavior persists upon alloying and gives way to Sn-like behavior only beyond roughly 65 % Sn. In the high-temperature phases, the B-site cations remain locally off-centered but directionally disordered. On the Ge-rich side, the distorted inorganic framework biases the soft MA orientational landscape toward a restricted set of preferred directions. This coupling shows how the composition of the inorganic sublattice can tune molecular ordering in lead-free hybrid perovskites.

title: Accurate predictions of mechanical properties using active learning on local chemical configurations: A case study of WC–Co composites
title_zh: 主动学习局域化学构型预测WC-Co力学性质
summary: 该文将主动学习用于WC-Co复合材料力学性质预测，强调从局域化学构型选择训练数据。核心思想应是把硬质相/金属粘结相附近的局域环境作为采样单元，提高小数据下的力学性质预测效率。给定摘要没有定量指标或具体性质，因此与团队的直接关联主要是主动学习材料建模方法，而非WC-Co体系。
abstract: Publication date: 25 August 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 273 Author(s): Faridun N. Jalolov, Viktor S. Baidyshev, Alexander G. Kvashnin

title: Computing high-order mixed derivatives in physics-informed neural networks using multi-index Bell polynomials
title_zh: 多指标Bell多项式计算PINN高阶混合导数
summary: 该文是PINN高阶导数计算的算法改进，目标是降低高阶混合偏导及其参数梯度的重复自动微分开销。核心做法是在指定向下封闭的多指标集合上递推多元Faà di Bruno公式，并预先制表Bell多项式卷积，同时给出显式反向传播。摘要未给加速倍率，但对含四阶弹性、相场、漂移扩散或高阶薛定谔型PDE的物理信息网络很实用。
abstract: arXiv:2609.03768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks for high-order partial differential equations require mixed input derivatives and their gradients with respect to the network parameters. Standard implementations obtain an order-K derivative by repeated automatic differentiation. We instead organize the forward recursion of the multivariate Faà di Bruno formula and its explicit backpropagation over a prescribed downward-closed set of multi-indices, with the Bell-polynomial convolutions tabulated once. The forward pass carries only the derivatives the differential operator requires. The backward pass propagates gradients from losses formed from any subset of them, including nonlinear products and coupled fields. Both recursions are exact up to roundoff and avoid nested computational graphs. An independent Taylor-jet implementation, symbolic checks of the test problems, and finite differences verify derivatives and loss gradients through order seven. On one CPU core, the method evaluates 330 mixed derivatives with respect to four inputs through order seven and the corresponding loss gradient without the memory failures observed for several nested implementations. Numerical tests include third-, fifth-, and seventh-order dispersive equations, incompressible flow, and a manufactured five-field electrohydrodynamic system. The seventh-order Zakharov-Kuznetsov test in 3+1 dimensions has a relative solution error of 6×10⁻⁴.

title: Computing stable configurations of confined smectic liquid crystals with a deep variational framework
title_zh: 受限近晶液晶稳定构型的深度变分计算
summary: 核心创新是用神经网络直接最小化近晶液晶连续自由能，避免在复杂边界中预设层状基函数。方法围绕修正 Landau-de Gennes 模型，将取向场和周期密度调制作为耦合变量，在变分损失中强制稳定构型。摘要未提供定量精度，但对凝聚态软物质中的缺陷、畴结构和受限几何能量景观求解有方法参考价值。
abstract: arXiv:2609.03389v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Smectic liquid crystals are layered liquid-crystalline phases characterized by orientational order and periodic density modulation. Although their structures can be modeled using continuum theories, computing stable configurations remains challenging in complex geometries, particularly when the high-frequency density modulations associated with smectic layering should be resolved. We propose a deep variational framework (DVF) for computing these configurations within the modified Landau--de Gennes model, in which the coupled orientational and positional order parameters are represented on a regular reference domain while physical confinement is incorporated through coordinate mappings. A warmup penalty mitigates the spectral bias of neural networks toward smooth, nonlayered fields, enabling robust recovery of oscillatory smectic states. Comparisons with a neural-network baseline and finite-difference relaxation demonstrate the essential role of this penalty and the numerical stability of the resulting layered states. The DVF reproduces experimentally established smectic-A defect structures and layer morphologies across diverse confinement geometries and further predicts a chevron-like smectic-C state in a tangent-anchored sphere. Together, these results demonstrate the applicability of the DVF to computing stable smectic configurations across experimentally relevant confinement geometries and anchoring conditions.

title: Oscillating Heat Transfer Prediction in Porous Structures Using Generative AI-Assisted Explainable Machine Learning
title_zh: 生成式可解释机器学习预测多孔振荡换热
summary: 亮点是把生成式拓扑扩增、LBM 数值实验和嵌套交叉验证的可解释预测串联，用于振荡流多孔结构换热。输入覆盖多种孔隙拓扑，目标是热性能而非原子尺度热导。摘要未报告定量最优结果，但对材料多孔结构设计中的形貌-输运映射和主动生成样本有启发。
abstract: arXiv:2509.11863v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting and interpreting thermal performance under oscillating flow in porous structures remains a critical challenge due to the complex coupling between fluid dynamics and geometric features. This study introduces a data-driven wGAN-LBM-Nested_CV framework that integrates generative deep learning, numerical simulation based on the lattice Boltzmann method (LBM), and interpretable machine learning to predict and explain the thermal behavior in such systems. A wide range of porous structures with diverse topologies were synthesized using a Wasserstein generative adversarial network with gradient penalty (wGAN-GP), significantly expanding the design space. High-fidelity thermal data were then generated through LBM simulations across various Reynolds (Re) and Strouhal numbers (St). Among several machine learning models evaluated via nested cross-validation and Bayesian optimization, XGBoost achieved the best predictive performance for the average Nusselt number (Nu) (R²=0.9981). Model interpretation using SHAP identified the Reynolds number, Strouhal number, porosity, specific surface area, and pore size dispersion as the most influential predictors, while also revealing synergistic interactions among them. Threshold-based insights, including Re > 75 and porosity > 0.6256, provide practical guidance for enhancing convective heat transfer. This integrated approach delivers both quantitative predictive accuracy and physical interpretability, offering actionable guidelines for designing porous media with improved thermal performance under oscillatory flow conditions.

title: Linearized subspace refinement framework to expose hidden accuracy in trained neural networks
title_zh: 线性化子空间精修揭示神经网络隐含精度
summary: LSR 的核心是在已训练网络的局部线性化模型中寻找子空间最优校正，而不是重新端到端训练。技术上构造雅可比低维子空间并解直接最小二乘，架构无关，可作为后处理提高科学机器学习预测精度。摘要未给数值提升，但对机器学习势、哈密顿量网络和张量性质模型的后训练校准很有方法价值。
abstract: arXiv:2601.13989v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Neural networks trained by gradient-based methods often exhibit optimization-induced accuracy plateaus in scientific machine learning tasks. We present Linearized Subspace Refinement (LSR), an architecture-agnostic post-training framework that exploits the local linearized model at a fixed trained state. By solving a reduced direct least-squares problem in a Jacobian-defined low-dimensional space, LSR computes a subspace-optimal linearized correction and yields a refined predictor with markedly improved accuracy. Across function approximation, data-driven operator learning, physics-informed operator fine-tuning, and noisy inverse problems, LSR shows that standard nonlinear training can remain far above this subspace-attainable error level. Similar accuracy plateaus persist even for the convex quadratic problem from local linearization when solved with standard iterative optimizers, identifying numerical ill-conditioning as a primary bottleneck. LSR frequently delivers order-of-magnitude error reductions, while the subspace rank provides an explicit capacity-control mechanism that balances correction strength, numerical stability, and noise sensitivity. Together, LSR exposes conditioning-limited attainable accuracy in trained-state linearized models and provides direct access to it.

title: Adaptive Learning of Periodic Solutions for Nonlinear Systems by Physics-informed Gaussian Process
title_zh: 物理信息高斯过程自适应求周期解
summary: 该方法把周期性先验直接嵌入高斯过程核与均值函数，用贝叶斯非参数回归近似非线性系统周期轨道。通过方程配点提供物理约束，并用不确定性驱动自适应采样，适合小数据下求解振荡动力学。摘要缺少定量结果，但对声子驱动、极化振荡或自旋动力学的降阶建模有潜在参考。
abstract: This paper presents a novel physics-informed Gaussian process (PIGP) for the adaptive computation of periodic solutions to nonlinear dynamical systems. The proposed approach is built upon two key steps. First, the Gaussian process (GP), as a Bayesian non-parametric machine learning framework, is employed to approximate the periodic solution without requiring a predetermined set of basis functions. To this end, tailored physics-informed periodic kernel and mean functions are constructed for GP regression. The nonlinear governing equation is then collocated to generate observational data, and in conjunction with an iterative linearization scheme, the periodic solution is obtained with both mean and covariance information. Second, recognizing that the performance of GP regression critically depends on the selection of collocation points, an adaptive collocation strategy based on variance-or residual-based criterion is developed to enable accurate and efficient solving of nonlinear systems. Numerical examples are conducted to validate the accuracy, robustness, and efficiency of the proposed PIGP. Notably, under the same level of accuracy, the PIGP demonstrates superior computational efficiency compared to the widely-recognized harmonic balance method (HBM).
